gen-righteous-gf-golos-text: Chunky, playful, and bent like steel rod. Righteous leads with bowls that fill the line, while Golos Text follows with a tall x-height and a widely parted s that keep paragraphs open.
gen-righteous-gf-hind-guntur: Commanding Righteous fills its bowls to the edge of the line, like thin steel rod bent into letters. And Hind Guntur, in sans-serif, can take a slightly larger size, since its wide curve gaps and tall lowercase keep it crisp.
gen-righteous-gf-hind-madurai: Righteous bends thin steel rod into bowls that fill the line, and that gives it real swagger. Then Hind Madurai, a plain sans, does the quiet work, its wide s curves and capital-tall lowercase carrying the text.
gen-righteous-gf-hind-mysuru: Hind Mysuru handles the text here, with no calligraphic thinning anywhere. Its lowercase presses close to the ascender height and each a is left ajar, so Righteous can carry the swagger up top.
gen-righteous-gf-huninn: Righteous bends thin steel rod into bowls that fill the line, which gives headings real command. Huninn, a plain sans, does the quieter job of carrying text.
gen-righteous-gf-karla: Fun runs through Righteous, whose thin steel rod letters keep a pencil-line consistency from end to end. Karla brings the strongest quality here: a gaping c and a tall middle band that make every line feel stocky and friendly.
gen-righteous-gf-kedebideri: Commanding Righteous holds its lines at one width through every turn, bowls filling out the whole line. Kedebideri offers a skyward x-height and rounded, inviting letters.
gen-righteous-gf-martel-sans: Righteous bends thin steel rod into bowls with steady pen pressure from first letter to last. Martel Sans brings the strongest quality here, generous openings and a high mean line that keep the text easy going.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Noto Kufi Arabic keeps a welcoming gap in its c and capitals barely above the lowercase. But shrink Righteous too far and its steel-rod bowls lose their command, so the heading wants room.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans: Glass-tube lettering, hollow and constant in thickness, gives Righteous its look. And Noto Sans, a sans with a wide-open c and lowercase filling most of the letter height, makes the strongest partner for it.
